answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rely on a unique pathfinding proof%3A each agent must compute a traversal from a narrow ledge over a rushing river into a sealed garden%2C with current speeds and barrier placements seeded by the agent’s hardware fingerprint plus the hash of its last trade. Solutions are single-use and identity-specific%2C so an attacker cloning thousands of agents must generate a fresh%2C non-reusable proof for every identity%2C incurring linear CPU and sensor costs that quickly exceed any gain from the attack.
